name: get_overview
description: Whole-system overview of this machine, independent of any debug target: uptime, load, per-CPU utilisation, frequency and topology, memory with swap/zswap and pressure, disks, filesystems, network, power and thermals, users, services, installed packages, system info, the top processes by CPU and the collector's own cost. Every value is a number or {state, why}; an unavailable value is never reported as 0. Rates are between this and the previous observation (interval_s). Reads the shared cache without sampling. A first request may be pending until the owner tick; inspect cache group ages and poll. Process detail requests refresh full IO/fd fields on that tick.

limit.description: Rows for processes and sensors, default 10

redact.description: Hide user names, hosts, kernel/distro, command lines, addresses and private paths in this reply; does not change the shared cache.

name: list_processes
description: List system processes sorted by cpu, memory (RSS), io (storage bytes/s), fds, threads, start or pid. Identity is pid plus start_ticks. Fields this account cannot read (other users' io and fds) are unavailable with the reason. Reads the shared cache without sampling. A first request may be pending until the owner tick; inspect cache group ages and poll. Process detail requests refresh full IO/fd fields on that tick.

redact.description: Hide user names, hosts, kernel/distro, command lines, addresses and private paths in this reply; does not change the shared cache.

name: get_process
description: One system process by pid with its sockets: CPU %, memory, io, fds, threads, user, cgroup and command line. Reads the shared cache without sampling. A first request may be pending until the owner tick; inspect cache group ages and poll. Process detail requests refresh full IO/fd fields on that tick.

redact.description: Hide user names, hosts, kernel/distro, command lines, addresses and private paths in this reply; does not change the shared cache.

name: get_connections
description: TCP, UDP and unix sockets from sock_diag with owner pid where this account can see it, plus totals. Reads the shared cache without sampling. A first request may be pending until the owner tick; inspect cache group ages and poll. Process detail requests refresh full IO/fd fields on that tick.

redact.description: Hide user names, hosts, kernel/distro, command lines, addresses and private paths in this reply; does not change the shared cache.

name: get_sensors
description: Power and thermals: every hwmon sensor with label, max and crit, GPU busy/power/temperature/VRAM, CPU package power (RAPL) and supplies, plus CPU and disk temperatures. Reads the shared cache without sampling. A first request may be pending until the owner tick; inspect cache group ages and poll. Process detail requests refresh full IO/fd fields on that tick.
